TITAN audit fixes landed 2026-09-29 (opencode, session s-20260929-20cd5e, leases in titan workspace). FIVE fixes, all test-verified, suite 1180 -> 1202 passed / 17 skipped. (1) scripts/screening/screen.py: backtest() only ever entered a position - pos set at :49, never reset, sole exit at the final bar - so n_trades was ALWAYS 1 and results.json recorded trades:1 in every cell, voiding the '0/15 concepts' row of ALPHA_SEARCH_TERMINAL_REPORT.md:27. Fixed by treating side_fn(i) as the DESIRED position (BUY long / SELL short / None flat), closing and reopening at the SAME next-bar open so a flip earns no free intrabar move; every concept in make_concepts() is already target-position shaped so no signal-fn change was needed. Verified on synthetic bars: flipping signal 1 -> 20 trades, always-long -> 1, never-signals -> 0. BARS_PER_YEAR=2190 deliberately NOT changed (should be 1610 for Dukascopy 4h) because it also moves the 200 pips/yr kill threshold - that is a gate re-registration, not a bug fix. (2) src/titan/execution/engine.py: fees=Money('0') was hardcoded at :736, so paper fills were free and any paper session would overstate PnL by the full cost. Added PaperConfig.commission_bps/spread_bps, _fill_fee() from fill notional, cost_model_configured property, and BrokerFill now reports the real fee.
